speaker: Captain Mira
text: Welcome aboard. The harbor has been quiet for days.

speaker: Old Fisherman
text: Nobody sails at night anymore. The fog is too thick.

speaker: Captain Mira
text: Then we leave at dawn. Prepare the ropes and the lanterns.

speaker: Young Sailor
text: Captain, the merchant wants twelve gold coins for the map.

speaker: Captain Mira
text: Pay him. That map is worth far more than gold.

speaker: Old Fisherman
text: Beware the lighthouse. Strange voices come from it.

speaker: Young Sailor
text: I heard the keeper vanished three winters ago.

speaker: Captain Mira
text: Stories will not stop us. Raise the anchor!
